name: pinned-sidebar-panel
description: Automatically restores a chosen sidebar panel after a timeout.
author: Bojan Raic

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions pinned-sidebar-panel.js && spicetify apply
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions pinned-sidebar-panel.js && spicetify apply && spicetify enable-devtools
scripts.undeploy: rm -f "$(spicetify path userdata)/Extensions/pinned-sidebar-panel.js" && spicetify config extensions pinned-sidebar-panel.js- && spicetify apply
